item.title: Park Circle Gallery to feature Upcountry Fiber Artists group exhibition
item.description: The City of North Charleston’s Cultural Arts Department is pleased to announce that a group exhibition featuring textile works by the Upcountry Fiber Artists will be on display at Park Circle Gallery from January 7-31, 2026.

item.title: South Carolina Blanks Orlando, 2-0
item.description: After a 32 save performance on Sunday, netminder Seth Eisele stopped all 25 shots he saw as he earned his fourth professional shutout in a 2-0 victory for the South Carolina Stingrays over the Orlando Solar Bears on Friday evening at the Kia Center.

item.title: How a Texas Medical Malpractice Attorney Helps Victims of Surgical Errors
item.description: When facing the aftermath of a surgical error, a Texas medical malpractice attorney is your advocate, traversing the intricacies of Texas law to guarantee justice. You need someone who comprehends the state’s strict statutes and damage caps. By meticulously compiling evidence and expert testimony, they craft a compelling case. item.title: Two Charleston Restaurants Make The New York Times’ 2025 Best Restaurant Dishes List
item.description: Two Charleston restaurants were included on The New York Times’ list of the country’s Best Restaurant Dishes for 2025. The Holy City was represented by the blowfish tails from Chubby Fish and the beef cheeks from Palmira Barbecue.

item.title: World-Famous Blue Angels to Headline 2026 Charleston Air Show
item.description: This week, Joint Base Charleston announced that the world-famous Blue Angels will headline the 2026 Charleston Airshow, which will be held May 2 and 3.
